acceptance_signals: One responsive Chinese HTML page presents a clear start, reading, answer, and result-copy journey without requiring repository navigation.
The page records eligibility attestation, start and finish time, elapsed seconds, six raw answers, participant questions, first uncertainty, extra sources, assistance, and confidence.
The shipped page contains no answer key or automatic pass/fail classification and clearly tells the participant not to ask the facilitator for content help.
All state remains in page memory; the page performs no network request, analytics, localStorage, cookie, repository write, upload, publication, or deployment.
Copy-result behavior works with the Clipboard API when available and a visible manual-copy fallback when it is unavailable.
Focused page tests, the complete supported Python 3.11 suite, task and repository governance, scope reconciliation, privacy scanning, and git diff validation pass.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-c1d2bf7439714aba9bd035fc13bc06b3 and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Add one self-contained Chinese static page that lets an unbriefed participant read the bounded Evidence Freshness material, start a timer, answer the six vocabulary questions, disclose uncertainty and assistance, and copy a privacy-bounded raw result without showing an answer key, scoring automatically, persisting data, contacting a network, or publishing the page.

items: Including the answer key or automatic scoring would invalidate the uncoached comprehension rehearsal.
Persisting participant responses or using network services would exceed the privacy and local-only boundary.
Clipboard access may be unavailable when the page is opened directly from a local file, so a manual fallback is required.
A browser timer is observational convenience rather than trusted or tamper-proof measurement.
The existing uncommitted completed-task changes will remain separate prior-task state and must not be absorbed into this task's ownership.
Reviewed assumption: A self-contained static page in the existing docs site is the smallest useful interface.
Reviewed assumption: The participant has a modern browser with JavaScript enabled.
Reviewed assumption: The page remains local until Git and publication are separately authorized.
Reviewed assumption: Building the page is an enabling slice; the real uncoached participant result remains a later human-run validation step.
Reviewed unknown: Whether a genuinely unbriefed participant completes the page without assistance remains unknown until the page is used.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the page should later become part of public navigation remains undecided and outside this task.

title: Build a simple Evidence Freshness rehearsal page
